title: Tai chi — Lenches Lakes and Rous Lench Village Hall
body: Tai chi every Wednesday evening: 5.30 to 6.30pm at Lenches Lakes and 7 to 8pm at Rous Lench Village Hall. The current block runs until the final session on Wednesday 9 December. Sessions suit complete beginners and adults of all ages and abilities. Tai chi is a complete mind-body movement programme that aims to increase flexibility, resilience, balance and strength, and gives time to tune in to ourselves and develop emotional equilibrium, clearer thinking and perspective. There are price options for blocks of 1, 2, 4 or 6 sessions: email mindtheqi@gmail.com for details and to book your place.
